record_title: Lucas–Carmichael prime triples in arithmetic progression
scientific_context: An if-and-only-if parametrization of Lucas–Carmichael numbers whose exactly three prime factors form an arithmetic progression, with one congruence ray for each reduced opposite-parity shape and a conditional Dickson-conjecture infinitude consequence.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The classical (6m-1)(12m-1)(18m-1) subfamily is prior art and is explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. No unconditional infinitude is claimed for any fixed shape. Guy (2004, §A13) and De Koninck (2008, Entry 399) were identified as residual-risk older sources but were not inspected in full.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact bounded verification of the arithmetic-progression classification and fixed-shape residue criterion.
Deterministic verification output: 186647 prime AP triples and 226000 shape/residue checks, both with zero mismatches.
